# Closed fixed frontend comparison

`original-aggregation.json` is the unchanged output of the reviewed read-only
aggregator with `inputs.json`: exit1,60 rows fully bound, all66 original reviews
retained. Six F11 rows stop at the original failed shared browser observation.
Remaining issues are the original F06 baseline interaction failures and all F09
fidelity failures, plus the preserved per-output mandatory failures.

`all-review-summary.json` descriptively joins all66 immutable independent grades.
It includes the six F11 reviews whose original observer failed; their separate
uniform dialog supplement resolves specific browser evidence without changing
those grades or original captures. It does not turn the original aggregate green.

Original native run bytes are in `../frontend-adoption-v3-results/`. Review JSONs
are in `../frontend-adoption-v3-review/`; F11 supplement and parent verification
are in `../frontend-adoption-v3-f11-http/`. Paths in original records remain their
actual execution paths. Restore the archive to a fresh destination when needed;
do not rewrite history to make old machine paths appear portable.

The fixed comparison fails adoption. Mean grades are descriptive ordinal scores,
not probabilities. Native token totals include host overhead and source byte counts
are not token counts; no skill-only efficiency, cost or latency claim is made.
